dataset_info.summary: Catalan sentences read in a studio for a speech-synthesis corpus and reused here to test transcription, trimmed and denoised by Projecte AINA. One row is one read sentence with its transcript, over 1,555 rows in all. The recordings are studio audio and the sentences are prepared — a deliberate domain contrast with the broadcast-style read speech of the other Catalan board.
dataset_info.notes: Projecte AINA FestCat (trimmed, denoised) — Catalan studio TTS-corpus speech repurposed as an STT eval, 1555+ rows across 8 shards, read sentences with transcripts. Only split available is 'train' (no dedicated test split in the source repo). Domain complement to fleurs-ca-ES: clean studio recordings vs FLEURS' broadcast-style read speech.
